title: P15.10-D: autonomous KPI evidence verification — owner-opt-in delegated verifier grant + receipt-bound canonical progress writes
description: Closes the P15.10-C KPI-UNVERIFIED gap: mission COMPLETED + artifact ACCEPTED never produced KPI progress. Adds ONE delegated verifier contract: owner-scoped grant objective_kpi_auto_authorization (KVA_) pinning business+objective+kpi+DELIVERABLE_BUNDLE rule+terms_version+expires_at (default OFF, ONE enabled grant per (objective,kpi), revocable, non-owner denied). New verifier kind kpi-verifier:<auth_id> in objective-authority assertOwnerVerifier — never owner impersonation; writer is the single canonical PAIR_KPI_VERIFIER. ObjectiveKpiVerificationService re-derives facts in ONE txn: workstream child folded DONE + WAL lineage + boundMissionForWorkItem + assertCanonicalMissionCompletion + >=1 ACCEPTED artifact bound via governed_task/mission; filename/self-report/LLM never count. On satisfaction writes immutable kpi_verification_receipt (KVR_) then calls EXISTING recordProgress with evidence_key kva:<auth>:<receipt_id>; P15.1 ledger gives replay idempotency + conflict. P15.5 assertCanonicalObjectiveKpiProgress re-validates grant+receipt (expiry/revoke/terms-drift/terminal fail closed). Operating pass calls advance once before §6 — TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE unchanged, never auto-ACHIEVED. MC route POST .../kpi-verification owner-scoped grant/revoke/disable/status. Tests: acceptance reproduces the gap end-to-end + 15 adversarial + contract edges. No merge/deploy; driver OFF.
